Package com.sicomsa.dmt.svc

Class ServiceFactory

java.lang.Object
com.sicomsa.dmt.svc.ServiceFactory
public class ServiceFactory extends Object
Creates services to call SAT's web service for downloading certificates, adapted to SAT's version 1.5 released 2025-05-30.

To create a new DMTService with defaults this should do:

 
      //Creates a new CFDI download service
      DMTService service = ServiceFactory.newCfdiServiceFactory().newService();
 
      //Creates a new Retenciones download service
      DMTService service = ServiceFactory.newRetencionesServiceFactory().newService();

Other methods are provided in order to create more specific services.

    • setSecurity

      public void setSecurity(OasisSecurity security)
      Sets de security to use in this factory.

      Initially the security is set to a stable default security.

      Security should be set before building the authentication service. Once the service is built, it will use the security set before its creation.

      Parameters:
      security - security to use.

    • setMessageFactory

      public void setMessageFactory(SvcMessageFactory messageFactory)
      Sets the SvcMessageFactory that will be used by the services built with this factory.

      This property is set to a stable default when factory is created.

      The services built before setting this property will use the one this factory had when they were built.

      Parameters:
      messageFactory - message factory to use by new services built.

    • newService

      public DMTService newService()
      Creates a new DMTService with default configuration.

      The security and message factory properties set will be used. If they are not set, the defaults will be used.

      Returns:
      a new DMTService with default configuration
